objective: Auditar en EDARSAHUB los inventarios fisicos mas recientes y ultimo log de sync para ORIGEN, 130QRO, ESTELAR, CIENFUEGOS y 130MID. Solo lectura.

queries.name: ultimos_inventarios_5_unidades
queries.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT unidad_negocio_codigo, server_id, sucursal_id, almacen_id, almacen, folio, fecha, sync_timestamp, sync_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unidad_negocio_codigo ORDER BY fecha DESC, sync_timestamp DESC, folio DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync WHERE unidad_negocio_codigo IN ('ORIGEN','130QRO','ESTELAR','CIENFUEGOS','130MID') AND sync_status IN ('ACTIVE','REPLACED')) SELECT unidad_negocio_codigo, server_id, sucursal_id, almacen_id, almacen, folio, fecha, sync_timestamp, sync_status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY unidad_negocio_codigo

queries.name: resumen_inventarios_5_unidades
queries.sql: SELECT unidad_negocio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS filas_sync, COUNT(DISTINCT folio) AS folios_distintos, COUNT(DISTINCT almacen_id) AS almacenes_distintos, MAX(fecha) AS fecha_inventario_max, MAX(sync_timestamp) AS sync_timestamp_max FROM dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync WHERE unidad_negocio_codigo IN ('ORIGEN','130QRO','ESTELAR','CIENFUEGOS','130MID') AND sync_status IN ('ACTIVE','REPLACED') GROUP BY unidad_negocio_codigo ORDER BY unidad_negocio_codigo

queries.name: ultimo_log_sync_5_unidades
queries.sql: WITH logs AS (SELECT u.codigo AS unidad_codigo, l.server_id, l.sync_start, l.sync_end, l.records_synced, l.status, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),l.error_message),300) AS error_message, l.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.codigo ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.Compras_Sync_Log l LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36),u.id)=CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36),l.unidad_negocio_id) WHERE l.sync_type='INVENTARIOS' AND u.codigo IN ('ORIGEN','130QRO','ESTELAR','CIENFUEGOS','130MID')) SELECT unidad_codigo, server_id, sync_start, sync_end, records_synced, status, error_message, created_at FROM logs WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY unidad_codigo
